verdict.rationale: Adyen's core integration is a server-to-server REST API (docs-1, docs-2) that can be called entirely headlessly with no UI dependency, supports idempotency keys for safe automated retries (adyen-docs-4, adyen-docs-25), and provides a dedicated test environment with test credentials explicitly meant for pre-production integration testing (adyen-docs-6, adyen-docs-18). Scoped, multiple API credentials support automated/service-account style access (adyen-docs-26, adyen-supp-api-credential-scoping). However, there is no explicit CI/CD pipeline documentation, no CLI/SDK testing harness, and the MCP server is documented as running locally via npx rather than as a CI-oriented headless service. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration guides, automated test-suite/SDK tooling, and confirmation of non-interactive credential provisioning for pipelines.
